== Summary ==
Lossless page extract from the complete official Set 8 PDF preserved by the Internet Archive [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005192157id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-8.pdf at 2021-10-05T19:21:57Z]. Extract page1 is original page1 (cover/header); extract page2 is original page6 (the three Light effect/interrupt slips). Text, vector icons and embedded source images are preserved without rasterization or lossy image recompression. The full original has eight readable pages,91,586,923bytes and SHA-256 <code>7c9bcdab4cba33e1af1225c88cd3b0aa6e73839dd3e01658d33369b9f7391cde</code>; it exceeds the Wiki upload size limit and remains unchanged in the source archive. Exact first publication day unknown. Extract SHA-256 <code>7e537b0c79a32fa5c82adeb99e9948123b116de4919dea095f8def8932dc19e2</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd.; published by the Players Committee.
